name: Research Flow
summary: Search the web and synthesize a concise, cited answer.

steps.note: Start broad, then narrow if needed
Pick 1-3 most relevant URLs from titles + snippets
Get full content of top result
Write tight answer, cite source URLs inline. No padding.

notes: Keep queries short (3-6 words) and specific — long queries degrade results
If first search misses, refine query and retry once before giving up
Prefer primary sources: official docs, papers, gov sites > aggregators
Never reproduce copyrighted text verbatim — always paraphrase
